name: Conflict Resolution
description: Provides an interest-based negotiation framework adapted for personal relationships with de-escalation sequences, structured dialogue steps, and resolution templates. Produces step-by-step conflict resolution plans with specific scripts for each phase. Use when the user asks about resolving a conflict with a partner, family member, or friend, needs de-escalation strategies, or wants a structured approach to disagreements. Do NOT use for workplace conflict mediation, legal disputes, assessing whether a relationship is healthy, or replacing couples counseling.
